title: What the Registers Count
description: Osric has kept the burial registers for forty years, and the numbers have stopped adding up: more names go into the ground than come out, and the oldest column — the walled-off Vault — is counting DOWN to something. He needs the crypt's own record shelves read against his, and the shades that guard them thinned. Descend to the archive, cross-check the tallies, and banish what won't let you read in peace.

objectives.desc: Reach the archive shelves in the crypt galleries
Banish the shades haunting the register shelves
Bring the crypt's tallies back to Father Osric
